hypotheses.reasoning: The Postgres data disk filled up. It was at 95% at 20:11, then 99%, and WAL growth was about 880MB/h. After that, writes failed with 'No space left on device'. order-service inserts into orders then failed with DiskFullError, so POST /checkout returned 500 at the gateway. Reads were unaffected. The audit-consumer crash loop, the billing-reconciler checksum errors and the card processor reset are unrelated red herrings.

verdict.recommendedAction: Free or expand disk on the postgres volume now. Check WAL/binlog retention and archiving, and clear any stuck replication slot. Add disk alerts well below 95%. Handle the audit-consumer poison message msg-478689 separately.
